{{Top}}
[[File:Rogue_Two_TCG.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Zev Senesca flying as Rogue Two during the Battle of Hoth]]
'''Rogue Two''' was the callsign used by certain fighter pilots of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]], and was typically reserved for the wingman of [[Rogue Leader/Legends|the squadron commander]].

The pilots who have used the callsign include:
*[[Tess Alder]] ([[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]])<ref name="SW15">[[Star Wars (2013) 15|''Star Wars'' (2013) 15]]</ref>
*[[Zev Senesca/Legends|Zev Senesca]] ([[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]])<ref name="TESB">{{Film|V}}</ref>
*[[Will Scotian/Legends|Will Scotian]] (3.5 ABY)<ref name="SOTE">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' novel]]</ref>
*[[Wister]] ([[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]])<ref name="ADitL">{{Tales|12|A Day in the Life}}</ref>
*[[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] (4 ABY)<ref name="XW: RL">[[X-Wing: Rogue Leader 1|''X-Wing: Rogue Leader'' 1]]</ref>
*[[Ibtisam]] ([[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]])<ref name="XWRS:MR">[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron 35|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' 35]]</ref>
*[[Peshk Vri'syk]] ([[6 ABY/Legends|6.5 ABY]])<ref name="XW:RS">''[[X-Wing: Rogue Squadron]]''</ref>
*[[Asyr Sei'lar]] ([[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]])<ref name="XW:TKT">''[[X-Wing: The Krytos Trap]]''</ref>
*[[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu]] (7&ndash;[[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]])<ref name="XW:SC">''[[X-Wing: Solo Command]]''</ref><ref name="XW:IR">''[[X-Wing: Isard's Revenge]]''</ref>
*[[Derek Klivian/Legends|Derek Klivian]] ([[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]])<ref name="IJ">''[[I, Jedi]]''</ref>
*[[Kral Nevil]] ([[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]]&ndash;[[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]])<ref name="NJO:DT">''[[The New Jedi Order: Dark Tide I: Onslaught]]''</ref><ref name="NJO:EL">''[[The New Jedi Order: Enemy Lines II: Rebel Stand]]''</ref>
*[[Kell Tainer]] {{C|Though he used the call-sign as a ruse, and was not an actual Rogue}}<ref name="XW:WS">''[[X-Wing: Wraith Squadron]]''</ref>
